description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This leadership role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a compassionate care environment, supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care. If you are a motivated nursing professional looking to advance your career in a supportive setting, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and compliance with healthcare regulations. This position is ideal for an experienced Registered Nurse who is passionate about leadership and committed to fostering a positive and effective clinical team. Join a facility that values its staff and provides opportunities for professional growth.
requirements: Previous experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and standards
Excellent clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to effectively manage and mentor nursing staff
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
